metasystem test · risk-selected tests and their proof

Read
  plan            preview the risk-selected tests and their reasons without running them
  list            every group in the committed testing contract
  status          whether an exact tree is already proven, and what its tests cost; nothing is run
  wait            wait for a proof attempt's recorded end

Work
  run             run the risk-selected tests for this checkout
  impact          run this unit's changed packages, named tests and affected contract groups
  groups          run named contract groups and their prerequisites for the proof command, without
                  recording proof
  declare-moves   record that this change moves or removes Stop test assertions on purpose
  baseline        record or check the trusted baseline a refactor proceeds from

Shape
  add             add verified Go tests, group inputs or surface paths to the testing contract
  remove          take deleted Go tests, group inputs, surface paths, a group or a surface out of
                  the testing contract

→ metasystem test ACTION --help  one action's forms, options and examples
